correctness.rationale: The multiplication table is expanded from all sixteen basis products and verified by direct finite-field enumeration. From it J=Ann_r and the quotient left-zero product follow with no characteristic assumption. Augmentation and coefficient equations establish every idempotent, including exclusion of all nonzero augmentation-zero solutions. Intertwining distinct right-module characters forces odd-characteristic automorphisms to be diagonal scalings or a swap, with no shear. In characteristic two the multiplication defect forces the quotient map to be identity/swap while every shear t:L->J is allowed; this proves completeness. Finite exhaustive p=2,3,5 and constructed GF4 checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The four-element dihedral quandle algebra is the first disconnected dihedral case and an explicit motivating test of a 2026 general automorphism problem. The theorem identifies the entire automorphism group in every characteristic, shows a structural shift from a multiplicative torus to a four-dimensional additive group, and relates it to a geometric shift from lines to planes and to transitivity. These are mathematically natural invariants and infinite finite-field families, not arbitrary small table increments.
